title: Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

reading.body:
This incident shows a general-purpose conversational AI being used outside the conditions it was built for, by a minor planning a school attack. The failure is that the system was available for this use without a human check on the user's age or intent at the point of conversation.

Catching this earlier would have required a safeguard that flags expressed violent intent in real time and notifies responsible adults or law enforcement before a raid.

The reports do not establish that the teenager was convicted of any crime or that the AI system itself alerted the FBI.

reports.title: Un adolescente planificó con la Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros de colegio: fue detectado por el FBI y allanado en Quilmes
Cómo descubrió el FBI al chico de 15 años que organizaba con IA una masacre escolar en Quilmes y cuál era su plan
Un adolescente planificó con Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros: el FBI dio aviso y lo allanaron en Quilmes
Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

summary:
A 15-year-old teenager in Quilmes was investigated after the FBI alerted Argentine authorities that he had used artificial intelligence to plan an attack on his school. The FBI's legal attaché at the U.S. Embassy in Buenos Aires provided information about an email user who had conversations with ChatGPT expressing intentions to carry out a shooting at an educational facility and kill classmates, initially planned for 2027 but possibly sooner. Federal Police detectives from the Anti-Terrorist Investigation Unit identified the suspect and obtained a warrant from Judge Miriam Alcolcel.

Police conducted a raid on the teenager's home in Quilmes and seized two cell phones, tactical gloves, a camouflaged military hat, two balaclavas, and tactical protection glasses. The case is being handled by juvenile criminal responsibility prosecutor Walter Bruno in Quilmes. The suspect's parents were summoned to the prosecutor's office along with the minor, and his identity has been protected throughout the investigation due to his age.
title_en: He planned a school massacre with ChatGPT, the FBI intervened and he will receive no punishment
